CustomField.description: Shows a total row under a Likert Matrix section: a live sum of the answered rows, with an answered count and a Partial flag until every row is answered. The total is display only unless the Total Score Field (Alternative Field) names a number field to save it to. Number mode always sums the mapped values; in Picklist mode a row counts only when its stored option value is a number. The row's wording comes from Total Score Label.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Show a live total under the matrix that adds up the selected answers, with an answered count while the matrix is incomplete. Select a Total Score Field to also save the score to the record; otherwise the total is display only.
CustomField.label: Show Total Score
